title: Pescara and Spezia face each other in Serie C following relegation
seoTitle: Pescara and Spezia Clash in Serie C
subtitle: Sunday's matchup brings together teams relegated in May and shakes up the Group B leadership.
excerpt: The duel between Pescara and Spezia shakes up Serie C with live broadcast. See details on squads, injuries, and coach expectations.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Spezia Calcio - Sito ufficiale, Abruzzo Popolare
contentHtml:
The decisive clash between Pescara and Spezia in Italy's Serie C, scheduled for this Sunday in Group B, is generating a buzz among fans and behind-the-scenes football circles. Both teams, which suffered relegation in May, now face each other at different points in the standings. While Spezia leads the competition, Pescara is trying to close the gap in points and positions to reach the top.

The impact of relegation and Spezia's leadership

This weekend's match marks the reunion of two clubs seeking recovery after being relegated in May. Spezia enters the duel occupying first place in the standings, being pointed out by Pescara coach Antonio Buscè as the team to beat in the championship. On the other hand, Pescara plays under the pressure of seeking a home victory to avoid losing ground in the fight for the top of the Serie C Group B table. Buscè is counting on the support of the local fans to push the team toward a positive result.

Television broadcast and club finances

The showdown will be broadcast live on television via the Raisport channel at 8:30 PM. The sporting value of Pescara's squad was highlighted by its own president, who stated that this is the strongest team assembled by the club in the last seven years. Spezia coach Marco Turati corroborated his rival's strength by mentioning that Pescara boasts Serie B-level forwards, including names like Inglese, as well as experienced athletes who recently won Serie C.

Absences and coaches' strategies

Pescara is dealing with injury problems in its squad for the game against Spezia. Coach Antonio Buscè confirmed that he will be without Altare, Merola, Ujkaj, and Eletu, the latter sidelined due to a new knee issue. Buscè plans to maintain the tactical structure with the 4-2-3-1 formation used in the previous victory against Sestri Levante, with Saio in goal and a midfield doubt between Meazzi and D'Ausilio. The coach is also monitoring the situation of Capellini and Fiorillo for the clash.

Call-up rules and the player market

Team preparation is also affected by national team call-ups. Marco Turati explained that the league allowed matches to be postponed if three players were called up, but Spezia could not request the change because Šapola missed out on the under-21 national team, leaving only the absence of the called-up Oyono. Turati also highlighted the integration of players after the end of the transfer window, citing the importance of athletes like Mateju in supporting the squad's younger players, while praising the recent performances of Cazzadori and Durmush.
